LanguageData.JiRikknit.label: ji rikknit
LanguageData.JiRikknit.description: Ji rikknit is a primitive variety of the drug family "spice" that is created from the ovum sac of the Rikknit creature native to planet New Plymto. It gives the user a brief euphoria but was not as addictive as other "spice" varieties.
